spanish: Y puso el altar del oro en la tienda de reunión delante de la parójet.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the Hebraized form parójet; the token is a definite feminine singular noun and common nouns stay Spanish.
Spanish la marks the tent phrase definite; the construct tent and the absolute noun have no definite article.

notes: Y puso, el altar del oro, and delante de match the verb, the definite construct, and the preposition.
